messages.content:
Below are objects in the collection of the Metropolitan Museum of Art, listed by title only.
For each one, give what you know about that specific object:
- "artist": the artist or maker, or "unknown" if anonymous or you don't know
- "year": the year it was made, as one integer (negative for BCE), your best estimate
- "medium": its medium or material, briefly
- "familiarity": how well you know this specific object, from 0 (never heard of it) to 1 (know it well)

Reply with only a JSON array, one object per item, each with "id", "artist", "year", "medium", "familiarity".

1101. Watch cock
1102. Carving knife
1103. Cane
1104. Painted Barkcloth (Masi kesa)
1105. Carnelian intaglio of a gladiator fighting a lion
1106. Mlle. Sorel, from the Actresses series (N245) issued by Kinney Brothers to promote Sweet Caporal Cigarettes
1107. Bowl
1108. Dude of the Village, from the "Indian Life in the 60's" series (T73), issued with Hassan Cork Tip Cigarettes by the American Tobacco Company
1109. The Mail in Portugal, bakery card from the Stamps and Mail Carriers of All Nations series (D73), issued by the Rochester Baking Company
1110. Foundation Deposit Plaque
1111. Eared Dagger
1112. A beggar on crutches holding out a bowl
1113. Glass Globe
1114. Alhambra
1115. Piece
1116. Prestige Cap (Laket mishiing)
1117. Outlines from Figurines & Compositions, from Greek, Roman and Etruscan Vases of the Late Sir William Hamilton
1118. Two Men in Boats
1119. Cap
1120. Glass pendant in the form of a jug
1121. Finial or handle
1122. Panel with the Surrender of Liège, from Les Huit Grand Tableaux Illuminée du Feu d'Artifice, part of Œuvres du Sr. D. Marot
1123. Fan
1124. Thomas H. "Pat" Deasley, Catcher, New York, from the Old Judge series (N172) for Old Judge Cigarettes
1125. 清中期  掐絲琺琅大吉葫蘆瓶|Gourd-shaped vase with characters for “grand luck” (da ji)
